title: Inverse scalar-adjunction action mate
statement: For categories and scalar adjunctions $T_Y\dashv r_Y$, $T_X\dashv r_X$, and functors $I_A,I_B$, define the inverse scalar mate of an action square $r_Y I_A\to I_B r_X$ to be its inverse adjunction mate $I_A T_X\to T_Y I_B$ [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate]. It is the actual mateEquiv construction with the specified units and counits, with independent object and morphism universes.
